objective: Test whether preserving independently pretrained topology and NT-conditioned latent spaces retains the observed SV and cCRE validation benefits.

starting_point.graph: Exact manuscript HPRC R2 SV graph; no release replacement
starting_point.topology_branch: Geometry-matched junction repair; bidirectional_default selected by reconstruction validation
starting_point.sequence_branch: Same repaired objective; frozen NT-v2 50M inputs; bidirectional_linear selected by reconstruction validation
starting_point.reason_for_new_comparison: NT-conditioned cCRE AP exceeds topology-only v2, while its SV AP is worse

units.pretraining: Oriented graph segments and degree-balanced, geometry-matched junction candidates
units.sv: HGSVC3 insertion/deletion example with paired breakend segments
units.partition: Fold A, seed 42, one-hop; existing chromosome split; development validation only

representation.definition: Ordered concatenation [48D topology, 48D sequence-conditioned], both frozen
representation.controls: Same 96 dimensions, retained windows, canonical identities and occurrence counts in every arm
representation.biological_probe: Existing standardized logistic probe and unchanged hyperparameter/calibration policy

endpoints.primary: Validation AUPRC for SV insertion/deletion and binary cCRE
comparisons: T_Q minus each matched-dimension partial/random arm
T_Q minus topology-only v2 and NT-conditioned single branches
endpoints.inference: One development fold/seed: point estimates only; no confirmatory CI or p-value

coordinate_ablation.question: Does NT-conditioned junction prediction benefit from the graph-message stream?
coordinate_ablation.remaining_inputs: Same 519 inputs including visible degree; coordinate attention remains. This is not a graph-free representation.
coordinate_ablation.head: Same selected linear interaction head
coordinate_ablation.budget: Same maximum 10 epochs, patience 3, seed 42, candidates and partitions
coordinate_ablation.selection_metric: Window-macro validation AUROC; report pooled AUPRC as well

validity_gates: Both branch checkpoints must match requested held-out and validation chromosomes, context and seed
Require exact branch segment identities, occurrence counts and extraction policy; reject silent intersections
Require identical biological example identities, labels and C+S/C+S+H predictions across all models
NT model and graph encoders remain frozen during every biological probe
Coordinate ablation must retain exactly the native candidate identities, NT cache and random initial weights
No test-chromosome scoring, biological-label feature selection, new tissue selection or matching-bin changes

decision_rule.retain_candidate: T_Q improves on Rt_Rq and both partial-random arms on both biological tasks after C+S+H, and remains within 0.005 AP of the better previously observed single branch on each task
decision_rule.if_failed: Report the failed contrasts and retain distinct task-specific candidates; do not expand a failing architecture to a full matrix
decision_rule.if_passed: Freeze this architecture specification, then evaluate an independently specified replication; one fold does not establish superiority
decision_rule.strict_context: Still ineligible under current geometry matching; do not silently relax the reconstruction protocol

implementation_requirements: Reuse native extractor and probes, adding optional companion checkpoint only
Store immutable command/checkpoint/resource receipts and all favorable and unfavorable results
Save exact source paths and machine-readable comparisons
limitations: Adaptively motivated development experiment; validation has already informed the design
Concatenation is a control and candidate representation, not a standalone novelty claim
No guaranteed performance improvement or journal acceptance
Measured genotypability outcomes and path correspondence remain external data requirements
